predictions.hair_over_dof: Negative paired ON-OFF residual on the same frozen OFF support.
predictions.bright_contour: Negative paired ON-OFF residual on the same frozen OFF support.
predictions.far_background_mean: Linear pre-grade background mean remains within the OFF repeat spread; no energy loss.

gates.transport: Every rendered K8 has 36 submitted samples: depth/final/AC/EB every frame, material/albedo at both ends. Every presented capture has eight consecutive frames. Missing/duplicate/nonfinite data is INVALID.
gates.registration: Reuse edge_flicker registration_structure/registered_run/shifted_mask. Exclude subtitle region for Dialogue3. Reject camera cuts and animation-confounded comparisons; never warp beauty frames.
gates.masks: Freeze masks from all 12 OFF windows: class-5 support against baseline depth discontinuities for hair-over-DoF, brightest 1 percent of baseline character contours, eroded depth-stable class-3 face control, far depth-stable background excluding character silhouettes. No candidate-derived mask or retuned threshold.
gates.residual: Dialogue3: 12 adjacent non-overlapping pairs. Even pair indices OFF->ON, odd ON->OFF; balanced time order reduces smooth drift bias. For each pair compute ON minus OFF of the same midpoint residual, independently for total/even/odd, rendered/presented, hair_over_dof/bright_contour. Exact one-sided sign test: improvement iff difference < 0; ties count against improvement. PASS iff binomial upper tail <= 0.05/12 (Bonferroni family: 2 domains x 2 regions x 3 residuals). Minimum 8 pairs derived from 2^-n <= 0.05/12. Fewer means insufficient alternations, never PASS. No min(OFF)-spread quality rule. Pixels, parity and K8 frames are not independent replicates. Registration failure invalidates the observable; no dropping failed windows. This tests consistent paired improvement; historical magnitudes are targets only. Arbitrary animation/serial dependence can still confound a live; no claim of universal phase cancellation.
gates.components: Decode rr_post_ac as C.rgb/A.a, rr_post_eb as bloom.rgb/exposure.a, Vulkan formats 97 (OFF) or 109 (ON). Report component residuals independently; exposure must stay fresh.
gates.energy: Energy traces retain rrpost slots 1 (effective AC), 2 (linear RR Z), 6 (effective EB), 384-wide nearest float32 RGBA *_p.f32 sidecars. Join trace rrpost image references to dumps.json. For ON, sample AC/EB at uv+jitter/renderSize from the energy jitter log; OFF samples at uv. Reconstruct the same chain_value (including rr_post_quantise R11 truncations) from Z, AC and EB. Compare fixed far-background float mean across all OFF/ON windows; report full-image dumps.json float means as an independent check. PNG/PQ means and isolated bloom means cannot pass the energy gate.
gates.timing: Separate timing-off-cost/timing-on-cost after captures, pan_post=0; active=1 temporal lines required in ON cost window; no diagnostics/builds/compiles overlap. S8 timing unchanged.
gates.qualification: Residual significance alone cannot qualify: valid transport/registration, nonempty face control, registered float energy, isolated cost and both scenes must pass. Keep key off in presets.

duration_derivation.settle_note: ON ceil(log(1/1024)/log(15/16)) = 108 frames; OFF 32 Halton frames. Shared live_flow rounds exclusive endpoints up to next 0.1 s.
duration_derivation.rendered_note: 1 + capture_at 0.1 + (9 capture + 3 completion presents)/30 + 1 write = 2.5 exclusive.
duration_derivation.presented_note: Capture transport is 2.3 s exclusive; FG status gate needs settings 1 + settle 1 + one 30-frame producer interval = 3 s exclusive.
duration_derivation.energy_note: max(trace_at=1, latency=1) + two presents/30 + write=1, rounded exclusive.
